name: @post/e2e-anonymous
description: Anonymous pages e2e (T0801 required test "anonymous e2e"): a plain-HTTP crawler (no JavaScript, no cookie) reads the built web app's served HTML for every public entity page — title, description, canonical, robots, OpenGraph, robots.txt, sitemap.xml — and a real Chromium visitor with a fresh context reads the same pages as a signed-out human; a private project, and every id that names nothing, must produce one identical, unindexable, name-free page. The Go API is a real HTTP mock served by this directory's mock-api.mjs so that the SERVER-side metadata reads are exercised too (a browser-level intercept cannot see them).
